replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, especially when faced with complex problems. My moderate neuroticism makes me worry about not understanding concepts quickly, but I usually overcome it with practice.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha for solving equations and understanding concepts. It was helpful, but I prefer human interaction for complex topics.

To find stationary points, first find the derivative of the function f'(x). Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are the stationary points.
